frontier.hypothesis: The reload1.c:2363 slot-REUSE path may never be taken anywhere in Bushido Blade 2, which would close the spill congruence class by measurement as well as by proof.
frontier.mechanism: It is the only path in alter_reg with no big-endian correction. s3 measured 23 synthetic shapes for func_80060E38 and it never fired (SImode and 8-byte-mode pseudos never co-allocate to a commandeered hard register); s4 adds ~94.5k randomized mutations and s5 adds 8 aggregate shapes plus a re-weighted 62.9k-iteration campaign, all negative. The TREE-WIDE question is still open and is now the only measurement left that could surprise.
frontier.next_probe: Forensics modality: use the instrumented cc1 at tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 (NOT build/cc1 -- see [[instrumented-cc1-location]]) to log every alter_reg call with (pseudo, from_reg, mode, total_size, chosen path, final offset) while compiling real src/*.c translation units, and count how often the 2363 REUSE path is taken and with what modes. Scope it to the TREE, not to func_80060E38 (s3/s4/s5 all answered that), and instrument small TUs first -- never recompile src/text1b.c whole.

frontier.hypothesis: The sanctioned C-level search space for this function is now complete, and the remaining ladder rung is synthesis rather than another search axis.
frontier.mechanism: Every slot-creation route in function.c has been individually measured (spill align -1 by closed form + probes; declared local align 0 by v_locals.c; aggregate BLKmode by s5's 8 variants), all three branches of alter_reg are accounted for (s2 closed form, s3 reuse kill), and both machine-search instruments are exhausted (random campaigns by construction and by ~159.5k samples; directed permuter has no applicable hint). The rederive modality's last sub-case (assign_stack_temp) was spent this session.
frontier.next_probe: Synthesis modality: assemble the s1-s5 chain into a single statement of what has been eliminated and what an accepted form would have to look like (nine single-word slots at stride 8 and congruence 0, from a 139-instruction leaf), and check that statement against the sanctioned-technique catalog for any family not yet tried -- rather than re-running any measured axis.

frontier.hypothesis: func_80060E38 is a member of a 29-function class defined by 'target contains a stride-8 reload-spill block', all blocked by the same measured fork property, and should be dispositioned as a class rather than ground one function at a time.
frontier.mechanism: Census (s2/spillscan2.txt): 29 stride-8 spill blocks tree-wide, all at 0 mod 8, all rule-carrying, none ever matched; the offset is congruent to -GET_MODE_SIZE(mode) (mod 8) under our BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN cc1, and cc1psx fed identical input produces target's congruence. Every surface that could change it (the cc1 binary/configuration, the Makefile, prologue_config.json, regfix/asmfix) is outside the grind edit surface, and [[no-compiler-divergence]] forbids the compiler-side fix.
frontier.next_probe: This remains an owner-surface question and the driver has NOT declared exhaustion, so it must not be escalated yet. Whichever session is assigned escalation modality should file the CLASS (not just func_80060E38) in docs/grind/decisions.md citing s2/spillscan2.txt, the closed-form proof, the cc1psx counter-exhibit, the s3 reuse-branch kill, the s4+s5 ~159.5k-mutation negative, s5's aggregate/taxonomy closure and s5's structural kill of the permuter's frame operator -- and must NOT cite Ruling-2, whose scope limit explicitly excludes non-crashing fork divergences.
